name: How it works, repeating cycle
description: Four steps arranged around a loop with a repeat icon in the middle.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Every two weeks we run the same cycle with your team, and each turn starts from what the last one taught us.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.help: Four steps, read clockwise from the top.

default.title: Plan
default.text: Pick one question worth answering and agree how you will know the answer.

default.title: Build
default.text: Make the smallest version that can answer it, usually in less than a week.

default.title: Measure
default.text: Put it in front of real customers and collect numbers and quotes side by side.

default.title: Learn
default.text: Decide together what to keep, change or drop, and write it down for the next turn.

fields.name: loopNote
fields.label: Closing note
fields.default: Then the loop starts again, with a sharper question each time.
